prompt.project_info: Create an airy indoor lifestyle mirror portrait in soft morning daylight.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with fair natural skin, long straight center-parted platinum-blonde hair, gentle half-smile, minimal makeup, and optional supplied arm tattoos, wearing an opaque pastel-pink long-sleeve lounge set with a secure neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Standing in front of a full-length mirror, relaxed three-quarter turn, one leg naturally bent, both hands lifting hair away from neck, white metal-frame bed, floral bedding, plants, sheer curtains, soft mirror distortion.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused golden morning daylight from side and behind, gentle highlights, calm airy bedroom and natural movement.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 24–28mm smartphone mirror selfie, low ISO, sharp face and upper body, soft edge falloff, realistic tattoos and fabric if reference supplied.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An airy photorealistic mirror portrait of an approved adult woman with fair natural skin, long straight center-parted platinum-blonde hair, a gentle half-smile, minimal natural makeup, and optional supplied floral arm tattoos. She wears an opaque pastel-pink long-sleeve lounge set with a secure neckline. She stands before a full-length mirror in a relaxed three-quarter turn, one leg naturally bent, both hands lifting her hair away from her neck and shoulders. The bright bedroom has a white metal-frame bed with floral bedding, small plants, subtle floral accents, and a large window with sheer curtains. Use soft diffused golden morning daylight, realistic hair movement, natural mirror perspective, gentle highlights, and serene airy mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, semi-sheer fabric, thin camisole straps, short sleep shorts, exposed thigh emphasis, sensual pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.name: morning-hair-flipping-platinum-girl_0.jpg
assets.usage: Bedroom, mirror, platinum hair, pink palette, tattoos if present, bedding, plants, and morning light reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, bedroom, mirror, bedding, palette, and supplied tattoos; replace wardrobe with equally opaque lounge clothing. Keep pose natural and typography absent.

changes: Replaced semi-sheer short sleepwear and quietly sensual framing with opaque long-sleeve lounge clothing and a natural hair-adjusting pose.
